observed_value: principal_amount_usd is blank on FX01 rows
anchor_value: source schedule shows non-USD par amounts requiring USD conversion

findings.detail: FX01 rows have non-USD par amounts in source, but principal_amount_usd is blank instead of holding an explicit USD conversion.

rationale: Class 2 row-validation issue. The source schedule columns identify Par Amount/Units separately from Cost and Fair Value. Representative flagged debt rows show par in CAD, GBP, and EUR, while the review artifact reports principal_amount_usd blank for non-USD debt rows. Because the platform rule requires an explicit USD principal for non-USD source par before par analytics, the missing converted principal is a real unit/FX normalization defect rather than a false alarm.
